def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full monochrome lines mark the separators between repeated panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def spans(size, seps):
        bounds = [-1] + seps + [size]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1)]

    row_spans = spans(h, sep_rows)
    col_spans = spans(w, sep_cols)
    blocks = [(rs, cs) for rs in row_spans for cs in col_spans
              if rs[0] < rs[1] and cs[0] < cs[1]]
    # The panel containing the motif is the least uniform panel.
    def variation(block):
        (r0,r1),(c0,c1) = block
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
        return len(set(vals))
    src = max(blocks, key=variation)
    (sr0,sr1),(sc0,sc1) = src
    tile = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for (r0,r1),(c0,c1) in blocks:
        if r1-r0 == len(tile) and c1-c0 == len(tile[0]):
            for i in range(len(tile)):
                out[r0+i][c0:c1] = tile[i][:]
    return out
